headlines.title: Banks expect to be hit with higher taxes in Budget
headlines.summary: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month.

headlines.title: Uzbekistan signs $4.7bn energy deals and outlines plans for two more nuclear power plants
headlines.summary: Foreign firms including ACWA Power, EDF and Toyota Tsusho are involved in projects covering 3,000 MW of generating capacity and 400 MW of storage. Tashkent is also preparing 128 oil and gas exploration blocks for investors and pursuing a future electricity connection to Europe.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: EU leaders clash over migration, Ukraine and budget in Brussels — but delay big decisions
headlines.summary: Leaders left crucial decisions on the bloc's long-term budget and Ukraine's financial needs to further gatherings in November and December.

headlines.title: Watch: Did Tesla really just unveil a flying car?
headlines.summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk showcased the vehicle at a facility owned by his SpaceX company, which helped develop the model.

headlines.title: Could Tesla’s flying car send sales and shares soaring?
headlines.summary: Tesla revealed its next-generation Roadster on Thursday in Texas, with one of the three new versions performing a jaw-dropping kickflip and demonstrating flying capabilities. However, analysts contacted by Euronews Business do not expect the model to generate significant revenue.

headlines.title: Why Chinese tech brands are outpacing Western rivals from EVs to robot vacuums
headlines.summary: From action cameras and smartphones to EVs and robot vacuums, Chinese brands are gaining ground worldwide, despite privacy and security concerns. What s driving their rise, and can European rivals keep up?

headlines.title: EU faces growing pressure to plug Ukraine s Starlink gap
headlines.summary: BRUSSELS — The European Union is under pressure to keep Ukrainian troops fully online after Elon Musk s Starlink was restricted amid volatile U.S. support for Kyiv. headlines.title: I find it quite demoralising in store - why I do all my shopping online
headlines.summary: After Primark announced plans for home delivery, we hear from women who never go into clothes stores.

headlines.title: Putin seizes five more European firms, continuing Russia's hostile asset crackdown
headlines.summary: The decree covers a flooring manufacturer, a paper packaging firm, a hygiene products maker, and two metal- and plastic-packaging companies, all of which continued operating in Russia after the all-out invasion of Ukraine in early 2022.

headlines.title: Trump s diesel deal with Russia is unlikely to significantly lower global fuel prices despite expectations of rapid relief
headlines.summary: As the world s largest diesel exporter, the US benefits from high prices. At home, however, consumers are feeling the strain of rising living costs. Why Donald Trump s deal with Russia is unlikely to change that.

headlines.title: 21 things we learned at the EU leaders’ summit
headlines.summary: From the budget and migration to a terrible smell in the press room, here’s POLITICO’s rundown of the latest European Council.

headlines.title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
headlines.summary: BBC Verify analysis of data from a UK maritime agency shows 12 vessels were struck in a week.

headlines.title: Risk of electric battery fire: VW recalls thousands of cars again
headlines.summary: Car maker Volkswagen is recalling more vehicles in Germany, this time electric models. Faulty batteries could, in the worst case, trigger fires.

headlines.title: Germany s China calculation shifts as import pressures eclipse export benefits
headlines.summary: Germany has long resisted tougher action against China, fearing retaliation. But rising pressure on key industries has pushed Berlin to seek stronger EU trade-defense powers to protect its industrial base.

headlines.title: In Europe s tech capital, Irish labor unions are booming amid AI-driven layoffs
headlines.summary: With Ireland's lucrative tech sector hit by waves of layoffs linked to AI, the country's nascent tech union has seen a spike in sign-ups from workers worried about their future.

headlines.title: Nandy 'minded to intervene' in Sky's £1.6bn takeover of ITV entertainment arm
headlines.summary: The culture secretary says the deal could affect free expression in the media and the variety of Britain's news landscape.

headlines.title: UniCredit cleared by ECB to take control of Commerzbank
headlines.summary: The European Central Bank has authorised UniCredit to exceed the 30% shareholding threshold in Commerzbank. The Italian lender expects to be able to take control of the German bank around the end of the year, subject to remaining regulatory steps and conditions.

headlines.title: Scottish government set to drop opposition to new oil and gas fields
headlines.summary: The SNP has had a long-standing “presumption against” new oil fields.

headlines.title: Living with a stink? Technology might help
headlines.summary: Smells from rubbish dumps and industrial facilities are being more carefully monitored.

trend_headline: ECB의 코메르츠방크 승인과 독일·프랑스의 자동차 정책 타협
summary: 유럽중앙은행(ECB)이 유니크레디트의 코메르츠방크 지분 인수를 승인하며 역내 은행권 대형 재편의 신호탄을 쏘아 올렸고, 프랑스와 독일은 '메이드 인 유럽' 및 자동차 배출 규제에서 극적인 타협을 이루며 전통 산업 방어에 나섰습니다. 아울러 독일은 중국발 수입 압박에 맞서 EU 차원의 강력한 무역 방어 수단 확보를 추진하고 있습니다.
